args.message:
Fix FIN-212: use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money

src/money.py documented ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212 but implemented
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to fail in the nightly build.
Switch the quantize call to ROUND_HALF_EVEN to match the spec.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix FIN-212: implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed on tests/test_money.py: `round_money` was documented (and required by FIN-212) to use banker's rounding, but the implementation used `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: switch the import and the `quantize` rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed (all tests, including `test_half_even`).
- Example: `2.675 -> 2.68`, `2.665 -> 2.66` (half rounds to even), matching the test expectations.

## Compliance
Implements the rounding requirement in FIN-212. Needs to ship in today's release.
